mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates reduce the present value of future equity cash flows and increase the cost of capital for firms.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 305.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher interest rates and reduced real earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of the federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% and the CPI index exceeding 300.0 signals a high-inflation, high-rate environment that triggers a flight to quality and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high rate regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 300.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and the labor force (PAYEMS) exceeds 156000, it indicates a tight labor market that drives wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 AND PAYEMS > 156000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400.0, it signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1400.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 103.0, it signals strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 103.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as elevated interest rates immediately increase the cost of capital and reduce the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP level (GDPC1) exceeds 20200.0 (billions of chained 2017 dollars), it signals robust economic growth that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 > 20200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
